blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The critically threatened Mindoro tamaraw, the country’s endemic symbol, could disappear unless authorities make a stronger effort to address habitat loss, poaching, and inadequate conservation funding, FPJ Panday Bayanihan Party-List Rep. Brian Poe said in a recent privilege speech he delivered before the House of Representatives. “I stand before you not just as a legislator, but as a Filipino grieving for a piece of our heritage that is slipping through our fingers,” Poe said. More than 10,000 tamaraws once roamed Mindoro in the early 1900s, he pointed out. But by 2025, their population had fallen to roughly 300. […]...
